prose.text:
Large power-station generators typically produce substantial electromotive forces, but generation, transmission, and use do not all require the same voltage.
Many electrical devices need a lower voltage, while long-distance transmission often uses a higher voltage.
For unchanged transmitted active power, power factor, circuit configuration, and line resistance, increasing the rms voltage reduces the rms line current and therefore resistive heating losses.
prose.source_text: 发电站的强大的发电机的电动势一般是相当大的. 同时，电能的实际应用中最经常要求的是不太高的电压，而电能的输送则相反，要求非常高的电压.
把某一频率的交流电的电压升高或降低几倍，而实际上没有功率损失，这个变换是靠**变压器**来实现的.

prose.text:
The source textbook recounts that the Russian inventor P. N. Yablochkov used the first transformers in $1878$ to power his "electric candles," a new form of lighting at the time.
It then describes how Moscow University researcher I. F. Usagin developed Yablochkov's theory and built improved transformers.
prose.source_text: 第一批变压器是在 $1878$ 年俄国学者 П·Н·雅布洛奇科夫为了供给他发明的“电烛”——当时的新光源——使用的. П·Н·雅布洛奇科夫的理论被莫斯科大学的研究员 И·Ф·乌沙金发展了，乌沙金研制了完善的变压器.

prose.text:
The transformer considered here has a closed iron core and two wire coils around it, although some transformers have more than two coils, as indicated in Figure $58$.
The coil connected to the alternating source is the **primary winding**, and the coil supplying the instruments or equipment called the "load" is the **secondary winding**.

Figure $59$ shows the two-winding structure, and Figure $60$ gives its simplified circuit symbol.
The names primary and secondary identify the source side and load side, not necessarily the higher-voltage and lower-voltage sides.
prose.source_text: 变压器由闭合的铁芯和在铁芯上套着的两个(有时是两个以上)导线线圈组成(图 $58$). 一个线圈叫做**初级**绕组，接在交变电源上，第二个线圈接在“负载”上，即需要电能的仪器和设备上，叫做**次级**绕组. 有两个绕组的变压器结构如图 $59$所示，它的简化符号如图 $60$ 所示.

prose.text:
A transformer works by electromagnetic induction: alternating current in the primary establishes a changing core flux, which induces an electromotive force in each winding.
The laminated steel core provides a concentrated path for this flux and helps reduce eddy-current heating.

In the model below, leakage flux is neglected, so the same main flux links every turn of both windings and has the same value through each core cross section.
This shared-flux assumption does not mean that a real core has no magnetic field outside it.
prose.source_text: 变压器的作用是以电磁感应现象为基础的. 当初级绕组中通过交流电时，在铁芯中出现交变磁通，它在每一个绕组里引起感生电动势. 变压器钢片做的铁芯使磁场集中，所以磁通实际上仅仅在铁芯内部才有，而且在所有截面中是相同的.

prose.text:
With shared flux and reference directions chosen for the same winding sense, the instantaneous induced electromotive force $e$ is the same in any primary or secondary turn.
Faraday's law relates it to the rate of change of flux:
$e=-\Phi',\qquad(3.1)$

Here $\Phi'$ is the time derivative of magnetic flux, and the minus sign expresses the direction required by Lenz's law.
For flux varying as a cosine, write:
$\Phi=\Phi_M\cos\omega t$

Differentiating with respect to time gives the following expression.
The flux amplitude and angular frequency together determine this rate of change:
$\Phi'=-\omega\Phi_M\sin\omega t\qquad(3.2)$

Substitution into Faraday's law gives a sinusoidal electromotive force in each turn.
In terms of the flux amplitude, it is:
$e=\omega\Phi_M\sin\omega t$

Alternatively, the same result can be written using the electromotive-force amplitude.
These are two descriptions of the same time-varying quantity:
$e=\mathcal{E}_M\sin\omega t\qquad(3.3)$

The amplitude relation is:
$\mathcal{E}_M=\omega\Phi_M$

Thus, at a fixed flux amplitude, a higher angular frequency produces a larger electromotive-force amplitude per turn.
This derivation assumes sinusoidal flux and the same flux linking every turn.
prose.source_text: 感生电动势的瞬时值 $e$ 在初级或次级绕组的任一匝中都是相同的，根据法拉第定律，它由下述公式确定$e=-\Phi',\qquad(3.1)$其中 $\Phi'$ 是磁感应通量对时间的导数，如果 $\Phi=\Phi_M\cos\omega t$，那么$\Phi'=-\omega\Phi_M\sin\omega t\qquad(3.2)$因此$e=\omega\Phi_M\sin\omega t$或者 $e=\mathcal{E}_M\sin\omega t\qquad(3.3)$其中 $\mathcal{E}_M=\omega\Phi_M$ 是在一匝里电动势的振幅.

prose.text:
The primary has $n_1$ turns whose electromotive forces add in series, so its total induced electromotive force $e_1$ equals $n_1e$.
The secondary's total induced electromotive force $e_2$ equals $n_2e$, where $n_2$ is the number of secondary turns.

When all turns link the same flux and electromotive-force references follow corresponding winding senses, the total electromotive forces are proportional to the turn counts.
Consequently:
$\frac{e_1}{e_2}=\frac{n_1}{n_2},\qquad(3.4)$
prose.source_text: 在具有 $n_1$ 匝的初级绕组里，总的感生电动势 $e_1$ 等于 $n_1e$，在次级绕组里总的感生电动势 $e_2$ 等于 $n_2e$ (其中 $n_2$ 是这个绕组的匝数). 因此得出：$\frac{e_1}{e_2}=\frac{n_1}{n_2},\qquad(3.4)$

prose.text:
For a simple primary voltage relation, neglect the voltage drops due to winding resistance and leakage flux, and assume that the alternating source maintains its specified terminal voltage.
Using the reference-direction convention recalled from Section $25$, the applied voltage approximately balances the winding's counter electromotive force:
$u_1\approx-e_1\qquad(3.5)$

The minus sign depends on the voltage and electromotive-force reference directions;
it does not indicate a negative root-mean-square voltage.
With internal voltage drops present, this balance is only approximate.
prose.source_text: 通常变压器绕组的纯电阻较小，即它们可以忽略不计. 因此，正如在第 $25$ 节已经阐明了的$u_1\approx-e_1\qquad(3.5)$

prose.text:
An open secondary carries no load current: this is the no-load condition, although the primary may still carry a magnetizing current that establishes the flux.
With the source textbook's reference directions for secondary terminal voltage and induced electromotive force, the no-load relation is:
$u_2\approx-e_2\qquad(3.6)$

This minus sign is also a reference-direction convention;
choosing the other terminal as positive changes the signed description.
Under load, winding resistance and leakage flux can additionally change the terminal voltage.
prose.source_text: 在断开变压器的次级绕组时，在次级绕组里不通过电流，并有下述关系式：$u_2\approx-e_2\qquad(3.6)$

prose.text:
For reference directions following corresponding winding senses, the instantaneous electromotive forces $e_1$ and $e_2$ vary in phase, reaching their peaks and crossing zero together.
The ratio in equation (3.4) therefore also equals the ratio of their root-mean-square values $\mathcal{E}_1$ and $\mathcal{E}_2$.

Using the approximations in equations (3.5) and (3.6), we may also compare the root-mean-square terminal voltages $U_1$ and $U_2$.
These values are nonnegative magnitudes.

The following equality holds in the ideal shared-flux model.
For a real transformer it is approximate at no load, while internal voltage drops affect it under load:
$\frac{U_1}{U_2}=\frac{\mathcal{E}_1}{\mathcal{E}_2}=\frac{n_1}{n_2}=K\qquad(3.7)$
prose.source_text: 因为电动势的瞬时值 $e_1$ 和 $e_2$ 的变化是同相位的，(同时达到最大值和同时通过零值)，那么在公式(3.4)里它们的比可以用这些电动势的有效值 $\mathcal{E}_1$ 和 $\mathcal{E}_2$ 的比来代替；或者考虑到等式(3.5)和(3.6)，可用电压的有效值 $U_1$ 和 $U_2$ 的比来代替：$\frac{U_1}{U_2}=\frac{\mathcal{E}_1}{\mathcal{E}_2}=\frac{n_1}{n_2}=K\qquad(3.7)$
量 $K$ 叫做**变压系数**. 在 $K>1$ 时变压器是降压的，而当$K<1$ 时，变压器是升压的.

prose.text:
Connecting the secondary terminals to an electrical load allows load current to flow in the secondary winding.
By Lenz's law, the magnetic effect of this current tends to oppose the flux change that induced it.

This describes the secondary current's contribution, not a prediction that the combined core flux must keep decreasing after a load is connected.
The response of the primary current must also be included.
prose.source_text: 如果次级绕组的两端连接在需要电能的电路上，或者如通常所说的，变压器加上负载，那么次级绕组里的电流强度就不等于零. 次级出现的电流在铁芯中产生自己的交变磁通，依楞次定律它应减弱铁芯里磁通的变化.

prose.text:
A reduction in combined flux amplitude would reduce the primary counter electromotive force, allowing the maintained source voltage to drive more primary current.
For a fixed source voltage and frequency with negligible internal voltage drops, the source textbook writes the magnitude relation from (3.5) as:
$|u_1|=|e_1|$

The additional primary current supplies a magnetic effect that approximately compensates for the secondary load current, keeping the steady-state flux amplitude close to its no-load value.
This response shows that load energy comes from the primary source, not from energy created by the core;
real input power must also supply losses.

In an alternating circuit, root-mean-square voltage times root-mean-square current is apparent power and equals real power directly only at unity power factor.
For general sinusoidal steady state, real power also includes the power factor;
neglecting losses and magnetizing current, equal power factors on the two sides can be canceled from real-power balance to obtain the relation below.

For the additional ideal resistive-load assumption used in this elementary treatment, both power factors are unity, so the relation also expresses approximate real-power balance.
With these conditions stated, the source equation is:
$U_1I_1\approx U_2I_2\qquad(3.8)$

Here $I_1$ and $I_2$ are the root-mean-square primary and secondary currents, respectively.
For a real transformer with significant magnetizing current, reactive components, or losses, these products cannot unconditionally be treated as equal real powers.
prose.source_text: 但合磁通振幅的减小应该使初级绕组里的感生电动势减小. 但是这是不可能的. 因为根据(3.5) $|u_1|=|e_1|$，所以在次级绕组闭合时，在初级绕组里电流强度自动增大. 电流振幅的增长使得合磁通的振幅恢复原先的量值. 在初级绕组电路里发生的电流强度的增大符合于能量守恒定律：向接在变压器的次级绕组上的电路输出多少电能，就必然要求线路初级绕组提供同样的能量. 初级电路上的功率应该近似等于次级电路上的功率：$U_1I_1\approx U_2I_2\qquad(3.8)$其中 $I_1$ 和 $I_2$ 是初级绕组和次级绕组的电流强度的有效值.

prose.text:
Within the ideal or low-loss model just stated, neglect magnetizing current and compare the root-mean-square values for a nonzero load.
Rearranging the power-product relation reverses the order of the currents relative to the voltages:
$\frac{U_1}{U_2}\approx\frac{I_2}{I_1}\qquad(3.9)$

Together with the earlier turn ratio, this means that load-current magnitudes vary inversely with the turn counts.
If both currents are referenced into corresponding same-polarity terminals, their compensating ampere-turn effects have opposite directions;
the root-mean-square ratio here carries no current-direction sign.

For the same transfer of energy under these approximations, stepping voltage up by a factor corresponds to reducing secondary current by that factor, while stepping voltage down corresponds to increasing secondary current.
This compares load currents on opposite sides of a transformer: it does not say that changing voltage across any fixed load always changes its current inversely, or that the device's power rating can be increased without limit.
prose.source_text: 这就是说，我们用变压器提高电压多少倍，电流强度也就减小了多少倍，反之亦然.

prose.text:
Real windings and cores heat up, so energy is lost and equations (3.8) and (3.9) are only approximate within their stated conditions.
For the large transformers of its own era, the source textbook states that "total energy losses do not exceed $2$ to $3\%$."

This is a retained historical textbook claim, not a universal loss limit for all transformers today.
Actual efficiency depends on design and operating load and must be assessed using the particular device's data and test conditions.
prose.source_text: 由于在线圈和铁芯中产生热，能量损失是不可避免的，因此方程式(3.8)和(3.9)是近似正确的. 但现代大型变压器的总的能量损失不超过 $2$—$3\%$.

prose.text: 发电站的强大的发电机的电动势一般是相当大的. 同时，电能的实际应用中最经常要求的是不太高的电压，而电能的输送则相反，要求非常高的电压.
把某一频率的交流电的电压升高或降低几倍，而实际上没有功率损失，这个变换是靠**变压器**来实现的.
第一批变压器是在 $1878$ 年俄国学者 П·Н·雅布洛奇科夫为了供给他发明的“电烛”——当时的新光源——使用的. П·Н·雅布洛奇科夫的理论被莫斯科大学的研究员 И·Ф·乌沙金发展了，乌沙金研制了完善的变压器.
变压器由闭合的铁芯和在铁芯上套着的两个(有时是两个以上)导线线圈组成(图 $58$). 一个线圈叫做**初级**绕组，接在交变电源上，第二个线圈接在“负载”上，即需要电能的仪器和设备上，叫做**次级**绕组. 有两个绕组的变压器结构如图 $59$所示，它的简化符号如图 $60$ 所示.
变压器的作用是以电磁感应现象为基础的. 当初级绕组中通过交流电时，在铁芯中出现交变磁通，它在每一个绕组里引起感生电动势. 变压器钢片做的铁芯使磁场集中，所以磁通实际上仅仅在铁芯内部才有，而且在所有截面中是相同的.

感生电动势的瞬时值 $e$ 在初级或次级绕组的任一匝中都是相同的，根据法拉第定律，它由下述公式确定$e=-\Phi',\qquad(3.1)$其中 $\Phi'$ 是磁感应通量对时间的导数，如果 $\Phi=\Phi_M\cos\omega t$，那么$\Phi'=-\omega\Phi_M\sin\omega t\qquad(3.2)$因此$e=\omega\Phi_M\sin\omega t$或者 $e=\mathcal{E}_M\sin\omega t\qquad(3.3)$其中 $\mathcal{E}_M=\omega\Phi_M$ 是在一匝里电动势的振幅.
在具有 $n_1$ 匝的初级绕组里，总的感生电动势 $e_1$ 等于 $n_1e$，在次级绕组里总的感生电动势 $e_2$ 等于 $n_2e$ (其中 $n_2$ 是这个绕组的匝数). 因此得出：$\frac{e_1}{e_2}=\frac{n_1}{n_2},\qquad(3.4)$
通常变压器绕组的纯电阻较小，即它们可以忽略不计. 因此，正如在第 $25$ 节已经阐明了的$u_1\approx-e_1\qquad(3.5)$
在断开变压器的次级绕组时，在次级绕组里不通过电流，并有下述关系式：$u_2\approx-e_2\qquad(3.6)$

因为电动势的瞬时值 $e_1$ 和 $e_2$ 的变化是同相位的，(同时达到最大值和同时通过零值)，那么在公式(3.4)里它们的比可以用这些电动势的有效值 $\mathcal{E}_1$ 和 $\mathcal{E}_2$ 的比来代替；或者考虑到等式(3.5)和(3.6)，可用电压的有效值 $U_1$ 和 $U_2$ 的比来代替：$\frac{U_1}{U_2}=\frac{\mathcal{E}_1}{\mathcal{E}_2}=\frac{n_1}{n_2}=K\qquad(3.7)$
量 $K$ 叫做**变压系数**. 在 $K>1$ 时变压器是降压的，而当$K<1$ 时，变压器是升压的.
如果次级绕组的两端连接在需要电能的电路上，或者如通常所说的，变压器加上负载，那么次级绕组里的电流强度就不等于零. 次级出现的电流在铁芯中产生自己的交变磁通，依楞次定律它应减弱铁芯里磁通的变化.

但合磁通振幅的减小应该使初级绕组里的感生电动势减小. 但是这是不可能的. 因为根据(3.5) $|u_1|=|e_1|$，所以在次级绕组闭合时，在初级绕组里电流强度自动增大. 电流振幅的增长使得合磁通的振幅恢复原先的量值. 在初级绕组电路里发生的电流强度的增大符合于能量守恒定律：向接在变压器的次级绕组上的电路输出多少电能，就必然要求线路初级绕组提供同样的能量. 初级电路上的功率应该近似等于次级电路上的功率：$U_1I_1\approx U_2I_2\qquad(3.8)$其中 $I_1$ 和 $I_2$ 是初级绕组和次级绕组的电流强度的有效值.
由此得出：$\frac{U_1}{U_2}\approx\frac{I_2}{I_1}\qquad(3.9)$
这就是说，我们用变压器提高电压多少倍，电流强度也就减小了多少倍，反之亦然.
由于在线圈和铁芯中产生热，能量损失是不可避免的，因此方程式(3.8)和(3.9)是近似正确的. 但现代大型变压器的总的能量损失不超过 $2$—$3\%$.
